name: Early-onset Inflammatory Bowel Disease-Ulcerative Skin Lesions-Immunodeficiency Syndrome
aliases: Early-onset IBD with Cutaneous Ulcerations and Immunodeficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for EOIBD-Ulcerative Skin Lesions-Immunodeficiency Syndrome

criteria.description: Onset of inflammatory bowel disease symptoms before 6 years of age
Presence of chronic, recurrent ulcerative skin lesions, often with neutrophilic infiltration
Laboratory evidence of immunodeficiency including hypogammaglobulinemia or impaired lymphocyte function
Exclusion of other known causes of early-onset IBD and immunodeficiency
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with immune regulation and epithelial barrier function

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: early-onset IBD, ulcerative skin lesions, and laboratory evidence of immunodeficiency
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory; exclusion of other monogenic causes is essential.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Chronic ulcerative cutaneous lesions with neutrophilic dermatosis
pathognomonic.notes: Typically painful and recurrent, often resistant to standard treatments
searchTerms: long-term skin ulcers with immune cell buildup
chronic skin sores with neutrophil inflammation
persistent skin lesions with neutrophilic dermatosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe early-onset inflammatory bowel disease with colitis
pathognomonic.notes: Usually presents before 6 years of age with bloody diarrhea and abdominal pain
searchTerms: severe early bowel inflammation with ulcers
early onset inflammatory bowel disease with colitis
chronic severe colon inflammation in young

pathognomonic.notes: Includes decreased serum immunoglobulin levels and impaired lymphocyte function
searchTerms: immune deficiency with low antibody levels

common.symptomName: Failure to thrive due to malabsorption
common.notes: Often secondary to chronic gastrointestinal inflammation
searchTerms: poor growth from nutrient absorption problems
not gaining weight due to digestion issues

common.notes: Painful mucosal ulcers in the oral cavity
Inflammatory joint symptoms may be present

searchTerms: low red blood cells due to chronic inflammation

occasional.notes: Mild to moderate enlargement may be observed
Delayed growth parameters compared to peers

searchTerms: eye inflammation affecting outer or inner layers
episcleritis or uveitis eye redness and pain
inflammation of eye's white or uveal layer

occasional.notes: Generalized or localized lymph node enlargement
Elevated liver enzymes or cholestasis in some cases
searchTerms: mild liver and bile duct abnormalities
minor liver and bile system irregularities

rare.notes: Rarely reported central nervous system involvement
Secondary to recurrent infections or immune dysregulation
Rare association with thyroiditis or diabetes mellitus

laboratory: Hypogammaglobulinemia with low IgG, IgA, and/or IgM
imaging: Endoscopic evidence of colitis with mucosal ulceration
Radiologic signs of bronchiectasis in some patients
other: Histopathology of skin lesions showing neutrophilic dermatosis

distinguishingFeatures: Eczema rather than ulcerative skin lesions
Profound T and B cell deficiency
Early life severe infections without IBD features
Absent or very low lymphocyte counts

redFlags: Severe bloody diarrhea with failure to respond to standard IBD therapies
Recurrent, severe infections despite antibiotic treatment
Persistent, painful ulcerative skin lesions unresponsive to topical therapies
references: Orphanet Report on Early-onset Inflammatory Bowel Disease-Ulcerative Skin Lesions-Immunodeficiency Syndrome, ORPHA:714477
Recent Advances in Monogenic IBD: Clinical and Genetic Features, Journal of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition, 2023
